blocking.title: The redone injectivity proof credits regression tests that never exercise the branch they are cited for: the closure, binary extern, set-member, fact, rule and predicate-name rejections of the guard are not tested in isolation, and the string/variable channel tests cannot attribute a denial to the guard at all (12 of 18 mutants survive)
blocking.detail: Mutation replay on src/authorize.rs blocks_roundtrip_safe (head 81ce4b5, 28 tests): killed = Term::Null->true, Term::Array->true, Term::Map->true, Op::Unary(Ffi)->true, checks unwalked, expressions unwalked (6). Survived with 28 passed = Op::Closure(..)->true, Op::Binary(Ffi)->true, Term::Set(_)->true (no member recursion), facts unwalked, rules unwalked, predicate name unchecked, rule body unwalked, rule head unwalked, Term::Variable->true, safe_string without the backslash rule, safe_string without the quote rule (11) plus Term::Parameter->true (equivalent: a built block carries no parameter). Raw output for the two class-C kinds the record names as closed: `M07_closure_pass: test result: ok. 28 passed; 0 failed` and `M06_binary_ffi_pass: test result: ok. 28 passed; 0 failed`. Cause for closure: both cited regressions (tests/authz.rs:1051-1074 case "closure" = `check if [1].any($x -> $x == 1);`, and tests/authz.rs:1077-1136 closure_check with `Op::Value(Term::Array(...))` first) are denied by Term::Array before the closure branch is reached. Cause for the A-channel tests (print_parse_string_injection_channels_fail_closed, print_parse_variable_name_injection_fails_closed, every_ascii_byte_in_a_string_term_either_round_trips_or_is_denied): the forged block 1 is also non-canonical for the structural validators (steps 7-8), which deny with the same code `auth.biscuit_invalid`; with the guard's quote or backslash rule removed the suite still passes (`M16: 28 passed`, `M17: 28 passed`, `M15: 28 passed`), so the counter named `denied_by_guard` (tests/authz.rs:1213, 1266) and the commit-56d6462 / SECURITY.md:238 / evidence C-section claims 'denied by the guard' are not what the suite proves. Five probe tests written in this pass (block-2 checks that evaluate true, so only the guard can deny: `{1}.any($x -> true)` via Op::Closure over a Term::Set; `1.extern::always(2)` via Op::Binary(Binary::Ffi); `{"a\""}.length() == 1`; a block-2 fact whose predicate name is `x); check if true; //`) pass on head and fail under the corresponding mutant — proof that the survivors are real gaps, not equivalent mutants, and that the missing tests are writable with the existing helpers. evidence/reviews/bfc2c0d/PRINT-PARSE-INJECTIVITY-6-0.md is declared immutable (line 3) and states at lines 437-446 that closure and extern rejection are covered by the two named regressions: that statement is false for closures and for binary extern calls. The record therefore has to be re-issued, not patched. Fleet memory: branch-level coverage already let a mutation through in 07/2026; this is the same defect class on a couche-3 security guard.

major.title: ecosystem-engine#13's form ('one copy in the fleet', git-dep into a non-member subdirectory of authz-biscuit) contradicts the precedent and the ADR clause it cites, is outside the owner decision as stated, and its failure modes are undocumented
major.detail: ADR-0020 §2.5 (governance docs/adr/0020, 'Décision de sécurité'): 'le patch cryptographique aes suit chaque workspace final dont le graphe contient aes' — the precedent notebook root Cargo.toml:30 comments '(design §5.2.4 — the patch travelled with its consumer)'. governance#91 quotes that principle ('Precedent: notebook/third_party/rustcrypto-aes-0.8.4 (ADR-0020 §2.5 — the patch travels with its consumer)') and, four lines earlier, records the opposite: 'ecosystem-engine does not carry a second copy: its [patch.crates-io] points at the authz-biscuit repository by git rev'. ADR-0020 §2.1 sets 'un repo par package/crate pour les satellites de code partagé'; a shared crate consumed by two repositories from a third_party/ directory that is not a workspace member is neither pattern. The owner decision of 2026-09-08 as quoted in this brief names Voie A + notebook precedent + §2.5, not a cross-repo git-dep. Reproduced offline: cargo resolves `biscuit-auth = { git = <authz-biscuit>, rev = 81ce4b5 }` by scanning the repository for a package named biscuit-auth (case 1 OK). With a second directory carrying the same package name (the natural state during a 7.0 requalification, or any copy left beside the first) cargo emits `warning: skipping duplicate package biscuit-auth v6.0.0 ... in favor of .../third_party/biscuit-auth-6.0.0/Cargo.toml` and exits 0 — the copy picked is decided by directory walk order, not by a manifest. Neither PR nor the note documents this. Options for the owner: (a) apply §2.5 literally — ecosystem-engine carries its own third_party copy + PATCH.md, byte-equality checked by a drift gate; (b) keep the git-dep and amend ADR-0020 §2.5 with the cross-repo form and its duplicate-name rule; (c) a satellite repository for the patched crate per §2.1 (rejected in the note as 'a second remote to govern for five lines of use').

major.title: No mechanism prevents ecosystem-engine#13 from merging with a rev that main will not contain; the stated consequence ('will no longer be reachable') is inexact in the direction that hides the problem
major.detail: ecosystem-engine#13 Cargo.toml:+33-34 and the PR body carry the rule in prose only ('must be re-pinned to the merge commit ... until then this PR must not merge'). ecosystem-engine scripts/*.ts contain no check on Cargo git revs (grep rev/git+ empty); `bun run check` (package.json:30) runs check:bun, toolchain, schemas, secret-scan, personal-data, lint, typecheck. `git ls-remote origin refs/pull/12/*` -> 81ce4b5 refs/pull/12/head: GitHub keeps PR refs after --delete-branch, and cargo fetches a full-SHA rev directly, so a stale rev keeps building indefinitely with no failure signal — the opposite of the 'no longer reachable' framing. A gate is needed: fail when the pinned rev of an intra-org git-dep is not an ancestor of the target repository's main (`gh api repos/libre-ai/authz-biscuit/compare/main...<rev>` status must be 'identical' or 'behind').
